Revolutionizing hoop games with multi-player competitive shooting! Real-time accuracy scoring, HD 3D visuals, and energetic gameplay promote fitness & social bonding. The ultimate choice for entertainment venues seeking active group experiences.



>> Features of Multiplayer Basketball:


  • Multiplayer Mode: Supports simultaneous play for multiple users, ideal for group competitions.

  • Real-Time Scoring: Precision sensors and tracking systems provide instant feedback on shots made.

  • HD 3D Graphics: Immersive visual display enhances realism and excitement during gameplay.

  • Game Variations: Includes time challenges, combo shots, and team vs team modes.

  • Performance Metrics: Tracks individual and group statistics like hit ratio, total shots, and reaction time.

  • User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive controls and game menus accessible to players of all skill levels.

  • Durable Construction: Built for high-frequency use in busy venues with reinforced components.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Multiplayer Basketball:


Encourages Social Interaction: Creates an energetic and engaging group experience that builds camaraderie.


Fitness Through Fun: Players stay active while enjoying the thrill of competition.


Ideal for All Ages: Accessible gameplay makes it popular with kids, teens, and adults alike.

Boosts Venue Traffic: A perfect centerpiece attraction for arcades, malls, amusement parks, and sports zones.


Event-Ready: Great for corporate events, tournaments, and party venues seeking team-based activities.


Flexible Installation: Customizable layouts to fit spaces large and small.



>> Product Number: LJST026


  • Floor area: 4m*5m*3m

  • Number of people: 1-4 person

  • Participation time: 3-10 minutes

  • Power: 110w



>> FAQs for Multiplayer Basketball:


Q1: How many players can compete at once?

A1: The system can be configured for 2 to 4 players in a match, depending on the installation setup.


Q2: How is scoring tracked?

A2: Infrared sensors and tracking technology monitor ball movement and register successful shots in real time.


Q3: Can players view their stats?

A3: Yes, individual and team scores, shot accuracy, and rankings are displayed on-screen during and after the game.


Q4: Is it suitable for outdoor use?

A4: This system is primarily designed for indoor use. Outdoor versions can be customized with weather-resistant features upon request.


Q5: Is it easy to maintain?

A5: Yes, the machine is built with durable components and includes a user-friendly maintenance system for daily operation.
